name: Diana Spencer
source:
Diana is a "childhood friend" of the [url=/c148291]protagonist[/url] from the beginning. From the same neighborhood he grew up in, to the present day after he's gotten out. Despite her attractiveness, she's quite withdrawn from socialization, tends to keep to herself more than not.

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/move-chains-plot-70773805]Patreon[/url]]

[url=/c148291]MC[/url]’s very slightly younger sister. Despite her attractiveness, she’s usually discovered in the wild alone with a pair of headphones and her face buried in something that isn’t the real world.

[In game description]
